About  
As an Embedded Systems Engineer at FinTech Innovators Inc., I bridge hardware and software to build reliable, secure solutions for financial technology. My work focuses on optimizing real-time systems and integrating edge devices into scalable fintech workflows. Over the past year, I’ve contributed to projects that balance precision engineering with compliance requirements, ensuring seamless performance in high-stakes environments.  

Key Skills  
- Developed firmware for real-time payment gateways using C/C++  
- Designed embedded Linux systems for secure transaction processing  
- Integrated IoT protocols (MQTT/CoAP) into point-of-sale terminals  
- Collaborated on RTOS-based architectures for low-latency operations  
- Automated deployment pipelines with GitLab CI for firmware updates  
- Engineered hardware-software interfaces for sensor-driven applications  
- Maintained network automation scripts for device management  

Let's Connect  
Let’s connect if you’re working on innovative embedded solutions or fintech hardware projects. I’m always curious about how others approach challenges at the intersection of systems engineering and financial technology.
